name: How does the kitchen work triangle factor into a layout remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does the kitchen work triangle factor into a layout remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The classic work triangle connects the sink, refrigerator, and cooktop to ensure efficient movement. While still a helpful guideline, modern kitchen design often focuses on dedicated activity zones. If multiple people cook together, breaking the kitchen into distinct prep, cooking, cleaning, and beverage stations is frequently more practical than a rigid triangle. When updating your layout, prioritize leaving ample landing space on both sides of the cooktop, placing the dishwasher directly adjacent to the sink, and ensuring the refrigerator is easily reachable without walking directly through the primary hot cooking zone.
acceptedAnswer.description: The work triangle connects the sink, stove, and fridge. It remains a solid guideline, though modern kitchens often use multi-cook functional zones for food prep, cleaning, and storage.
